roomSummary: This is an open-plan room with carpet throughout, extending from a spacious living area in the foreground to a dining space in the midground and a kitchen at the far end.
camera: The camera stands in the front living area, looking directly down the length of the room toward the kitchen peninsula and back wall.

landmarks.description: White kitchen peninsula bench dividing the kitchen from the main living and dining space
Two dark pendant lights hanging over the kitchen bench
Wall-mounted heat pump high on the right wall near the kitchen
Tall vertical window on the right wall looking out to the yard
High horizontal window on the right wall in the foreground
Interior passage doors along the left hallway wall leading toward the kitchen
Double power outlet on the lower section of the prominent left wall

walls.name: Left foreground wall
walls.description: Solid, white protruding wall section on the left with power outlet, facing into the living space

walls.name: Left corridor wall
walls.description: Recessed left wall with interior passage doors leading to the kitchen

walls.name: Right wall
walls.description: Long perimeter wall containing a high horizontal window in the foreground and a tall window in the midground

walls.name: Far kitchen wall
walls.description: Back wall containing kitchen cabinetry, rangehood, and fridge alcove

zones.name: Living Zone
zones.description: The carpeted area across the foreground and midground, bounded by the left foreground wall and right perimeter wall

zones.name: Dining Zone
zones.description: The carpeted area directly in front of the kitchen peninsula bench

zones.name: Kitchen Zone
zones.description: The tiled zone at the back behind the kitchen peninsula bench

fridgeSpace.description: Recessed tall alcove to the left of the kitchen cabinetry and rangehood

layout.placement: Against the solid left foreground wall, centered below the light switch and over the double power outlet
Standing neatly on top of the low TV unit against the solid left foreground wall
Positioned across the carpeted living area facing the TV unit on the left wall, with its back toward the right wall under the high horizontal window
Centred in front of the three-seater sofa in the living zone
Under the coffee table and front feet of the sofa to define the living zone
Centred in the dining space in front of the kitchen peninsula bench, positioned lengthways across the room
Tucked neatly along both long sides of the dining table

relationships: The dining table stays in the midground directly in front of the kitchen bench, leaving a clear separation between the dining area and the living space.
The sofa faces the left wall TV setup, maintaining a clear open walkway down the left side into the kitchen.
The living area furniture is kept entirely forward of the tall window on the right.
avoid: Do not place the dining table between the sofa and the TV unit.
Do not block the hallway doors along the left side with any furniture.
Do not push furniture directly against the tall window on the right.
Do not place tall furniture against the right wall that would obstruct the high horizontal window.
keepUntouched: Kitchen peninsula bench, cabinetry, rangehood, and splashback
Pendant lights over the kitchen bench
Heat pump on the upper right wall
Tall vertical window and high horizontal window on the right wall
Interior doors and trim on the left hallway wall
All light switches and wall outlets
